release_invariants.ordinary_search: The deterministic documentation search remains separate and is neither queried nor ranked by assistant answer quality, relevance, timing or conversation code.
release_invariants.knowledge: Only reviewed, publishable, versioned and provenance-tracked local material may become RAG evidence. Model-weight training is not a default knowledge-update path; M13-07A permits a reversible adapter experiment only after the approved benchmark proves evidence, retrieval and composition remediation insufficient.
release_invariants.privacy: No prompt, answer, evidence, hardware identifier, timing sample, credential or conversation content becomes telemetry. External evidence remains retained implementation only and never becomes local RAG knowledge in 0.9.3.
release_invariants.locale: Every visible string, evidence item, retained turn and retrieval result is exact-active-locale only; cross-locale fallback, merge and retained-context reuse are forbidden.

answer_contract.completeness: The answer must contain the complete grounded response needed for the accepted question. A word count, paragraph count or latency target must not silently shorten it; hard parser, context, cancellation and resource safety bounds remain explicit.
answer_contract.validation: A factual claim requires current accepted evidence. Unsupported, malformed, contradictory or irrelevant output clarifies, abstains or refuses; raw evidence excerpts and raw model output are never substituted as a plausible answer. A schema/citation-valid but excessively extractive local draft may make exactly one isolated local rewrite from its private draft and accepted citation IDs, then must pass the original evidence checks again.
answer_contract.citation: Only current accepted source identities may support an answer. A source list is optional, deduplicated and cannot make an unsupported answer valid.

benchmark.local: M13-06A executes ten approved support intents as native reviewed EN/RU prompts (20 cases). The bilingual result is the selected-model control reported for all six product locales, but it never permits cross-locale retrieval or a claim that another locale was independently executed. Citation resolution, explicit-context relevance and safe behavior are 100%; each supported answer must receive at least 4/5 reviewer relevance and completeness; long raw evidence extraction is zero.
benchmark.external: Deferred beyond 0.9.3 by product-owner decision: no external-source benchmark, configured provider request, reader switch or external claim is a release requirement. The retained implementation may be reconsidered only in a separately approved investigation.
benchmark.remediation: Correct evidence/relevance first, then approved RAG corpus, then composition/prompt/runtime. A local adapter is conditional, reproducible, rights-cleared, trained off the target laptop and must improve failures without regressing a passing benchmark case.

universal_relevance.rule: Before generation, source rendering or fallback, every explicit request constraint must agree with the candidate evidence. A missing supporting context clarifies or abstains; an incompatible context is rejected and is never silently substituted.
universal_relevance.regression_fixture: The Russian question `Как установить BPM на Ubuntu?` selects the published same-locale Ubuntu 26.04 source-install procedure. Debian 13.5 evidence is incompatible and cannot reach answer text or sources.

conversation.scope: One browser tab, one exact locale and one BPM version.
conversation.retention: Retain the newest eight completed user-question/assistant-answer pairs across documentation navigation and reload. The ninth completed pair deterministically evicts the oldest. Clear, tab close, locale/version change, expiry and process restart remove context as applicable.
conversation.follow_up: Every accepted follow-up receives a fresh answer and fresh same-locale retrieval informed only by its bounded retained context. Cancelled or failed turns stay visibly terminal, do not count as completed pairs and never block a later request.
conversation.external_boundary: Retained context is never sent to an external provider. In 0.9.3 every browser chat request is local_only; no reader switch or provider request is emitted.

time_preview.display: Immediately after an accepted request, the transcript renders locale-owned preliminary copy equivalent to `Expected time: from N minutes S seconds to M minutes T seconds`. The completed answer or explicit terminal failure atomically replaces that preliminary message.
time_preview.calibration: Compute a conservative local lower and upper range in whole seconds from bounded installation/runtime measurements; recalibrate after model installation or a material runtime change. The calculation uses no network, telemetry or stable hardware identifier and does not delay request admission.
time_preview.honesty: The range is an estimate, not a deadline. It must widen for unknown or cold conditions and must not be used to truncate, cancel or deprioritize a valid answer.

sources_and_viewport.local_links: Relevant local documentation sources are active same-window links to validated same-locale BPM documentation.
sources_and_viewport.external_links: External-source navigation is deferred beyond 0.9.3 and is not present in the released assistant UI.
sources_and_viewport.desktop_panel: The expanded lower-right assistant overlay is 50vw wide and 90dvh high; title, composer and status remain visible while only the transcript scrolls.
sources_and_viewport.responsive_accessibility: Narrow-view fallback, light/dark/forced-colors rendering, keyboard operation and safe text-only rendering remain mandatory.

implementation_sequence.BPM093-M13-06B: Enforce selected-model structured JSON generation without weakening grounding.

verification.implementation: Each referenced M13 task supplies its focused runtime, UI or browser proof; this planning contract adds no route, model invocation, generated answer, provider call or browser mutation.
